text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Countries that are long-standing liberal democracies World
Classification by Lührmann et al. (2018) based on expert estimates by V-Dem. Liberal democracies are political
systems that hold meaningful, free and fair, and multi-party elections, and their citizens have further individual
rights, are equal before the law, and the legislative and the courts constrain the executive.

tspan.tspan: The share of closed autocracies increases a lot in 1900 because V-Dem covers many more countries since then, often colonies.
